{"idea":"The function equalities show that each of x² and y² is either 2 or 3. Their strict ordering forces x² = 2 and y² = 3.","proof":"  rw [h₀, h₁] at h₂ h₃
  have hx : (x ^ 2 - 2) * (x ^ 2 - 3) = 0 := by
    nlinarith [h₂]
  have hy : (y ^ 2 - 2) * (y ^ 2 - 3) = 0 := by
    nlinarith [h₃]
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hx with hx | hx <;>
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hy with hy | hy <;>
    nlinarith","insight_statement":"x ^ 2 = 2 ∧ y ^ 2 = 3","insight_proof":"  rw [h₀, h₁] at h₂ h₃
  have hx : (x ^ 2 - 2) * (x ^ 2 - 3) = 0 := by
    nlinarith [h₂]
  have hy : (y ^ 2 - 2) * (y ^ 2 - 3) = 0 := by
    nlinarith [h₃]
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hx with hx | hx <;>
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hy with hy | hy <;>
    constructor <;> nlinarith"}
